poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.ent:
Fingertip Incantations
Edit slots, keys and layout
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.hot:
Mixed (default): slots 1–9 are the vanilla hotbar, with number keys, scrolling and pick block as usual; the row moves as one.
Fingertip: slots 1–9 can be bound, moved and deleted freely, and refill from the next stack.
Slots 10 and up work the same in both modes. Switching never moves items or changes bindings.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.nat: Works as in vanilla; the row moves as one
These nine are the vanilla hotbar; bind skills and actions to other slots
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.off: Shows your off-hand item; hidden while your off hand is empty. It can be moved, but not deleted or bound.
The off-hand frame cannot be deleted; it can only be moved.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.nat: The vanilla hotbar uses this key; choose another
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.sho: This key is currently used by vanilla or the wheel, so this slot is paused; its binding and position are kept
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.key: Saved, but %s isn't taken over (see Key takeover); this slot is paused.
Saved, but the middle button opens the wheel; this slot is paused.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.sho: %s isn't taken over (see Key takeover); this slot is paused, its binding and position kept.
The middle button opens the wheel; this slot is paused, its binding and position kept.
Shortcut paused: %s. It resumes once the conflict is gone; the binding and position are kept.

the whitelisted action %s uses the same key
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.sna:
On: dragged slots line up with nearby ones at the chosen gap.
Off: drag freely. Arrow keys always nudge.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.whi:
On: this mod keeps its own keys.
Off: use it through slots.

poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.lay:
Click a slot to set its key; drag to move it. Drag on empty space to select; Shift/Ctrl-click adds or removes. Move or arrange the selection together.
Tab hides the editor. Changes apply at once; deleting asks first.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.tak: F1–F9 can be bound to slots; keys dimmed below keep their usual function.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.use: When you right-click with an item held through a slot, other mods see its real inventory slot (Sophisticated Backpacks needs this to open a held backpack). Turn it off if a mod misbehaves.

poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.tak: Once F3 is taken over, pressing it alone no longer opens the debug screen; F3 combinations still work.
While E is taken over, the wheel stays on so you can open the inventory.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.whe: On: the middle button opens the wheel, and slots bound to it pause. Choose Drag or Click at the bottom left.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.rea: Drag in to bind · Drag to an empty spot to clear · Tab hides the editor
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.whe: Point at an action · Center or Esc closes
· Click for one, hold to keep dropping; the wheel stays open
· Click for a stack; the wheel stays open
Release over an action to run it · Release in the centre to cancel

Drag: hold the middle button and release over an action to run it once, or in the center to cancel; Drop also runs once.
Click: middle-click opens the wheel; click an action to run it. Drop can be clicked again and again while the wheel stays open.
Either way, the center, right-click or Esc closes it.
Fingertip Incantations is fixed at the bottom of the wheel.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.ena: Master switch. Off restores every key; your layout and bindings are kept.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.whe: With E taken over, the wheel is how you open the inventory, so it stays on; stop taking over E first.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.can: Tab hides the editor for a moment
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.whe: Inventory is fixed at the top of the wheel.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.del: Slots, bindings and keys are removed; your items are unaffected.
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.dra: Release to swap with slot %2$s (keys stay)
poris_elegies_fingertip_incantations.cle: Only the binding is cleared; the slot, its position and key stay, and items are unaffected.

Dark crimson, gold, roses and crystals. Every state keeps the same frame; selecting lights up its gold rim.

Hide the slots in game; keys still work
Only hides mod action slots; skills and items still show, and keys still work
